name: kdocs-knowledge-collector

displayName.zh: 金山文档知识收藏助手

displayDescription.en: By Kingsoft Docs Turn scattered web articles, messages and notes into structured knowledge: one-click clipping to cloud docs, AI-powered note organization by topic, and auto-summarization across multiple documents.
